the electric pulse treatment has a significant influence on the apatitic layer on NiTi shape memory alloys,and the quality and the purity of the apatitic can be improved by changing the pulse parameters and the consistence of the calcification solution.

the electric pulse treatment can enhance the quality and purity of apatite coating,and the optimal pulse parameters are as follows:the pulse frequency is 1 Hz,electric current density is 0.5 mA/cm2 and treatment time is 5 min.
